Dietary Supplement

Glutathione, a powerful tripeptide naturally produced in the body, offers health benefits as a master antioxidant. 21st Century® Glutathione supports cellular detoxification, immune function, and helps neutralize harmful free radicals. Milk Thistle Extract and Alpha Lipoic Acid are added as complementary ingredients. 
Suggested use
As a dietary supplement, adults take one (1) capsule daily, preferably on an empty stomach, or as directed by a healthcare provider. Do not exceed recommended dosage. 
Other ingredients
Cellulose, magnesium silicate. Contains <2% of: Magnesium stearate. 
No artificial colors, artificial flavors, artificial sweeteners, preservatives, wheat or yeast.
Warnings
Individual results may vary. 
Consult a healthcare provider prior to use if pregnant, nursing, on medications, have a medical condition or are planning a medical procedure. Stop use and contact a physician if adverse reactions occur. 
Keep out of reach of children. Do not use if product appears to be tampered with or seal is broken. Store at room temperature.
